title: EPFO Launches 'VISHWAS 2026' One-Time Penalty & Damages Dispute Resolution Scheme
summary: Operational for 6 months to settle Sec 14B EPF penalty disputes with reduced damages.

blocks.content: Operational for 6 months to settle Sec 14B EPF penalty disputes with reduced damages.

items: Dispute Settlement: One-time resolution scheme for penalty disputes under Sec 14B EPF Act 1952 and Sec 128 Code on Social Security 2020.
Reduced Damages Scale: Defaults before June 14, 2024 get reduced damages of 0.25%/month (up to 2 months), 0.50%/month (2-4 months), and 1%/month (>4 months).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: VISHWAS 2026 scheme duration (6 months) vs default cutoff date (June 14, 2024).
